title: Prepositions in relative clauses
summary: Предлог в придаточном определительном: в конце (разговорно) или перед **whom / which** (формально), а также модели **some of whom, in which case**.
ru:
## Два места для предлога
Когда глагол или прилагательное в придаточном требует предлога (*talk to, work for, depend on*), у нас есть два варианта.
> The woman **I spoke to** was the director. — Женщина, с которой я разговаривал, была директором. (нейтрально и разговорно)
> The woman **to whom I spoke** was the director. — (формально, письменно)

**Предлог в конце** — естественный стиль речи, переписки и большинства текстов. **Предлог перед whom / which** — официальный и письменный стиль: деловые письма, научные работы, юридические тексты.

## Как это работает
При предлоге в конце можно использовать **who, that, which** или вообще **ничего**:
> The pen **(that / which)** she wrote the letter **with** was a gift.
> The people **(who / whom / that)** we were talking **about** didn't turn up.

Когда предлог переносится вперёд, остаётся только **whom** (люди) и **which** (вещи):
> The pen **with which** she wrote the letter was a gift.
> The people **about whom** we were talking didn't turn up.
- ~~the man to who I spoke~~ → the man to **whom** I spoke
- ~~the pen with that she wrote~~ → the pen with **which** she wrote
- ~~the film about I told you~~ → the film **about which** I told you (или: the film I told you about)

## Что нельзя делать
Не нужно **дублировать** предлог и не нужно ставить **where** вместе с предлогом.
- ~~the hotel where we stayed in~~ → the hotel **(that) we stayed in** / the hotel **where we stayed** / the hotel **in which** we stayed
- ~~the company for which she works for~~ → the company **for which** she works
- ~~the man I spoke~~ → the man I spoke **to** (предлог нельзя потерять)

Когда предлог относится к **фразовому глаголу**, тяжело перенести его вперёд: *the children I look after*, *the idea she came up with*. Предлог после **whom / which** тогда звучит искусственно, и лучше оставить его в конце.

## Количество + of whom / which; устойчивые обороты
Предлог **of** с количественным словом всегда стоит перед **whom / which**: *He gave three reasons, **only one of which** was convincing.* Другие формальные фиксированные выражения: ***in which case*** («в таком случае»), ***at which point*** («в этот момент»), ***by which time*** («к тому времени»).
> We may be late, **in which case** we'll call you. — Мы можем опоздать, и в этом случае позвоним вам.
> The talks collapsed at midnight, **by which time** most delegates had left.

## Выбор стиля
- Разговорная речь, письма друзьям, блог: *the woman I spoke to*.
- Деловая переписка, отчёты, научный текст: *the woman to whom I spoke*.
- Нельзя смешивать: ~~the woman to whom I spoke to~~.
en:
## Two places for the preposition
When a verb or adjective in the clause needs a preposition (*talk to, work for, depend on*), we have two options.
> The woman **I spoke to** was the director. (neutral, conversational)
> The woman **to whom I spoke** was the director. (formal, written)

**A final preposition** is natural in speech, emails and most texts. **A preposition before whom / which** belongs to formal writing: business letters, academic papers, legal documents.

## How it works
With a final preposition we can use **who, that, which** or **no pronoun at all**:
> The pen **(that / which)** she wrote the letter **with** was a gift.
> The people **(who / whom / that)** we were talking **about** didn't turn up.

When the preposition moves to the front, only **whom** (people) and **which** (things) are possible:
> The pen **with which** she wrote the letter was a gift.
> The people **about whom** we were talking didn't turn up.
- ~~the man to who I spoke~~ → the man to **whom** I spoke
- ~~the pen with that she wrote~~ → the pen with **which** she wrote
- ~~the film about I told you~~ → the film **about which** I told you (or: the film I told you about)

## What to avoid
Don't **repeat** the preposition, and don't use **where** together with a preposition.
- ~~the hotel where we stayed in~~ → the hotel **(that) we stayed in** / the hotel **where we stayed** / the hotel **in which** we stayed
- ~~the company for which she works for~~ → the company **for which** she works
- ~~the man I spoke~~ → the man I spoke **to** (never lose the preposition)

With **phrasal-prepositional verbs** it is hard to move the preposition to the front: *the children I look after*, *the idea she came up with*. Putting the preposition before **whom / which** sounds stiff, so leave it at the end.

## Quantifier + of whom / which; fixed phrases
**Of** with a quantifier always comes before **whom / which**: *He gave three reasons, **only one of which** was convincing.* Other formal fixed phrases: ***in which case***, ***at which point***, ***by which time***.
> We may be late, **in which case** we'll call you.
> The talks collapsed at midnight, **by which time** most delegates had left.

## Choosing the style
- Conversation, emails to friends, blogs: *the woman I spoke to*.
- Business writing, reports, academic text: *the woman to whom I spoke*.
- Don't mix them: ~~the woman to whom I spoke to~~.
structure:
## Два варианта
| Разговорный | Формальный |
|---|---|
| The man **I spoke to** | The man **to whom** I spoke |
| The man **(who / that) I spoke to** | — (только **whom**) |
| The pen **(that / which) she wrote with** | The pen **with which** she wrote |
| The company **she works for** | The company **for which** she works |

## Что можно после предлога
| Предлог в конце | Предлог впереди |
|---|---|
| who, whom, that, which, ничего | **whom** (люди), **which** (вещи) |
| the hotel **(that)** we stayed **in** | the hotel **in which** we stayed |

## Фиксированные формальные обороты
| Оборот | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **in which case** | в таком случае | It may rain, **in which case** we'll stay in. |
| **at which point** | в этот момент | The lights went out, **at which point** he left. |
| **by which time** | к этому времени | We arrived at ten, **by which time** it was dark. |
| **some / most / none of whom / which** | часть группы | ..., **none of whom** replied. |

## Формулы
> существительное + (**that / who / which**) + подлежащее + глагол + **предлог**
> существительное + **предлог + whom / which** + подлежащее + глагол

exercises.title: Предлог + whom / which
exercises.example: The man to ___ I spoke was the manager. → The man to **whom** I spoke was the manager.

items.text: The colleague with {{whom}} I share an office is on leave.
The committee to {{which}} she belongs meets weekly.
The reason for {{which}} the meeting was postponed was never explained.
She is a person on {{whom}} everyone can rely.
The project, in {{which}} we invested millions, has failed.
The people for {{whom}} the event was organised didn't attend.
That was the moment at {{which}} everything changed.
He gave three reasons, only one of {{which}} was convincing.

exercises.title: Предлог в конце
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужный предлог в конец придаточного.

items.text: That's the woman I was talking {{to|with}}.
Is this the pen you wrote the letter {{with}}?
The hotel we stayed {{at|in}} was lovely.
What's the name of the company she works {{for}}?
The topic they were arguing {{about|over}} was trivial.
The film everyone is talking {{about}} is sold out.
The problem we were dealing {{with}} turned out to be simple.

items.q: The man to ___ I spoke was the manager.
The house in ___ she was born has been demolished.
The agency ___ she works is based in Berlin.
items.why: Предлог + **which**: **for which**. **That** после предлога не бывает.

options: The man to whom I spoke was kind.
The man I spoke to was kind.
The man with whom I travelled was kind.
items.why: Предлог в конце и пропуск местоимения — разговорный стиль.

items.q: The tools ___ he repaired the car were old.

options: The girl to that I talked was shy.
The girl to whom I talked was shy.
The girl to who I talked was shy.

items.q: He asked three questions, none of ___ I could answer.
items.why: **None of which** — количественное слово + of + which.

options: The hotel where we stayed in was lovely.
The hotel we stayed in was lovely.
The hotel in where we stayed was lovely.
items.why: Нельзя сочетать **where** с предлогом, но «the hotel we stayed in» верно.

options: She is the woman for who I work.
She is the woman for whom I work.
She is the woman whom I work for her.
items.why: Предлог перед придаточным требует **whom**, без повторения предлога.

items.q: В каком предложении можно опустить местоимение?
options: The man with whom she travelled was kind.
The man (that) she travelled with was kind.
The man in whom she confides is kind.
items.why: Опустить местоимение можно, только если предлог стоит в конце; если предлог впереди, после него обязателен **whom**.

items.q: We may be late, in ___ case we'll call you.
She is the person on ___ I rely.

options: The book which I was looking is lost.
The book I was looking for is lost.
The book for I was looking is lost.
items.why: Предлог **for** нельзя потерять: **the book I was looking for**.

exercises.title: Формальный вариант
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, переместив предлог перед **whom** или **which**.

items.prompt: The woman I spoke to was the director.
answers: The woman to whom I spoke was the director.

items.prompt: The company she works for is based in Oslo.
answers: The company for which she works is based in Oslo.

items.prompt: The pen I wrote the letter with was a gift.
answers: The pen with which I wrote the letter was a gift.

items.prompt: The people I was sitting next to were rude.
answers: The people next to whom I was sitting were rude.

items.prompt: The experiment we relied on failed.
answers: The experiment on which we relied failed.

items.prompt: The committee she belongs to meets weekly.
answers: The committee to which she belongs meets weekly.

exercises.title: Соедините предложения
exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения в одно, используя придаточное с предлогом. Если допустимо несколько вариантов, подойдёт любой.

items.prompt: The man was a friend. I borrowed money from him.
answers: The man from whom I borrowed money was a friend.
The man I borrowed money from was a friend.
The man who I borrowed money from was a friend.
The man that I borrowed money from was a friend.
The man whom I borrowed money from was a friend.

items.prompt: The hotel was lovely. We stayed at it.
answers: The hotel we stayed at was lovely.
The hotel at which we stayed was lovely.
The hotel that we stayed at was lovely.
The hotel which we stayed at was lovely.

items.prompt: He had three assistants. None of them spoke English.
answers: He had three assistants, none of whom spoke English.

items.prompt: The report was long. I was asked to comment on it.
answers: The report I was asked to comment on was long.
The report on which I was asked to comment was long.
The report that I was asked to comment on was long.
The report which I was asked to comment on was long.

items.prompt: (Use some of which) She mentioned several books. I had read some of them.
answers: She mentioned several books, some of which I had read.

items.prompt: (Use with whom) The colleague is on leave. I share an office with him.
answers: The colleague with whom I share an office is on leave.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя предлог в придаточном.

items.prompt: Describe a person you work or study with. Use with whom.
items.sample: I have a colleague with whom I share a love of jazz.

items.prompt: Write about a hobby. Use a clause with a final preposition, e.g. something I'm interested in.
items.sample: Photography is a hobby I've been interested in since school.

items.prompt: Describe your workplace or school. Use in which or for which.
items.sample: I work for a small company in which everybody knows each other.

items.prompt: Write about a friend. Use a clause like the person I can always rely on.
items.sample: My sister is the person I can always rely on.

items.prompt: Describe a city you have visited. Use in which case, at which point or by which time, if you can.
items.sample: We arrived in Rome late at night, by which time all the shops were closed.

items.prompt: Write about something you often talk about with friends.
items.sample: The topic we talk about most often is football.
